description: Get a Maps Census report. Once ready: its title, criteria, table (a header line, then one line per group; raw counts, with the legend's marks for hidden figures) and key points, plus the PDF URL for a full report. Until then: the status and when to retry. The status is counting, then for a full report writing (the written analysis) and pdf (the PDF being built), then ready.
